wave-color-title.name: Player Wave Trail Color
wave-color-title.description: Color override for the Wave Trail.

wave-rgb-title.name: Player Wave Trail RGB
wave-rgb-title.description: Wave Trail RGB Cycle. Will override custom Wave Trail Color.

solid-wave-trail-title.name: Solid Player Wave Trail
solid-wave-trail-title.description: Makes the Wave Trail a solid color instead of it blending with the background and being glowy.

wave-trail-size-title.name: Player Wave Trail Size
wave-trail-size-title.description: The size multiplier the Wave Trail will have.

wave-pulse-size-title.name: Player Wave Trail Pulse Size
wave-pulse-size-title.description: The pulse size multiplier the Wave Trail will have.

no-wave-pulse-title.name: No Player Wave Pulse
no-wave-pulse-title.description: Disable Wave Trail pulsing to the song.

keep-trail-on-death-title.name: Keep Player Wave Trail On Death
keep-trail-on-death-title.description: Prevents the Wave Trail from fading out on death.

no-trail-behind-title.name: No Player Regular Trail Behind
no-trail-behind-title.description: Hides the regular trail while in the Wave gamemode.

button-in-pause-menu.name: Button in Pause Menu
button-in-pause-menu.description: Whether or not to show the Wave Trail settings button in the pause menu.

open-menu.name: Open Settings Keybind
open-menu.description: The keybind that will be used to open this menu.
